name: Lotte New York Palace
positioning: Midtown Manhattan hotel rooted in the Gilded Age Villard Mansion, with The Towers rooms and suites on its top floors
best_for: Travelers who want history and St. Patrick's Cathedral views in Midtown
Guests looking for large, distinctive suites with butler service

facts.text: The hotel is rooted in the Villard Mansion, built by Henry Villard in Italian Renaissance Revival style and designed by McKim, Mead & White.
The Gilded Age history tour is complimentary to guests and gathers in the Grand Lobby.
The Towers has a private lobby and check-in and maitre d'etage butler service.
The Royal Suite Collection suites range from 2,500 to 5,000 square feet with panoramic skyline views.
The concierge team are Les Clefs d'Or concierges.
The hotel has a spa, ila only Spa.
Rockefeller Center and MoMA are among the Midtown sights near the hotel.
Bergdorf Goodman is less than a ten-minute walk from the hotel.
FAO Schwarz's flagship store is two blocks from the hotel.
Steve Cohen's Chamber Magic performs each Friday and Saturday evening in the hotel's Madison Room.
The full fee for the St. Patrick's Cathedral VIP tour is donated to the cathedral.
MITANI New York is the newest outpost of Tokyo's Sushi Mitani.

highlights.text: The Palace Historian leads a one-hour guided tour of the Villard Mansion, one of New York City's few surviving Gilded Age mansions.
The hotel's St. Patrick's Cathedral VIP tour includes the lower halls and staircases, the main altar, the bishop's crypt and the choir loft.
The Jewel Suite, created with jewelry designer Martin Katz, is a triplex with a two-story crystal chandelier and a terrace-level hideaway with a wood-burning fireplace.
The Champagne Suite spans three floors, with a two-story marble parlor, a wine cave and a rooftop terrace with a custom waterfall spa.
Cathedral View rooms look out on St. Patrick's Cathedral and Rockefeller Center.

considerations.text: Panoramic skyline views of Manhattan's West Side are offered by the Skyline Cathedral View rooms, which are on higher floors.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury Manhattan location.
WhataHotel notes a busy tourist area with heavy foot traffic.
